name: Omkar-App
description: Omkar Samithi - Cultural & spiritual community app for Oman Karnataka Aradhana Samithi in Muscat

paragraphs: Omkar Samithi is a bilingual (English/Kannada) community platform for the Oman Karnataka Aradhana Samithi, a cultural and spiritual organization based in Muscat, Oman.
features: ✨ Scroll-driven logo animation (every tab) — at scrollY = 0 the single Omkar logo sits large and exactly centred over the full-screen hero while the title, tagline and diya row are anchored to the bottom of the screen…

📅 Upcoming programs with live countdowns, per-event reminders and a permanent one-click Add to Calendar (.ics) button — dimmed until the date is announced. The Samithi sets each program's date once in the dashboard;…

🪔 Diya lamps that follow the year — each lamp lights 30 days before its own program and, once lit, stays lit until New Year. The row fills up through the year (one lamp, then two, then all three) and goes dark again on…

🗓️ Festival calendar — a wall-calendar month grid with every festival and program under its date and today highlighted in gold; click a chip to download the .ics. The festival dates are worked out from the panchang for…
🙏 Seva — volunteer opportunities (Food, Flowers, Oil Lamps, Incense, Temple Bells, Cleaning) with a registration form fixed to Sri Anjaneya Pooja (yearly program dates shown; no date picker)

whatItDoes.text: Omkar Samithi is a bilingual (English/Kannada) community platform for the Oman Karnataka Aradhana Samithi, a cultural and spiritual organization based in Muscat, Oman.

requirements.text: Open /#/admin on the site and sign in with Google.
Setup (about 10 minutes, once) is in supabase/README.md: create a project, run the SQL, add your email to the admins table, enable Google sign-in, then put the URL and anon key in config/.env.local.
Blogger's public feed needs no API key — it sends no CORS headers, so it is loaded over JSONP (no proxy, no server).
Create an access token at vercel.com/account/tokens
